title: StackChoicesAddModelRequest
description: STACK-MODELS-PAGE-01. The body of `POST /stack/v1/choices/add-model`: a Hugging Face link, optionally the file, the level, and whether to use the model now.

file.description: The .gguf file when the repository has more than one.

use.description: Select the model for the category and level now. Default true.
